name: angelo-plugins
description: Plugins Claude Code d'Angelo Lima : sécurité, workflows git, tests E2E Playwright, statusline, SDLC assisté par IA (Kaizen), motion design et plus

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Blocks access to sensitive files, scans commits for leaked secrets, and provides circuit breaker utility

plugins.name: notifications-system
plugins.description: System sound & OS notifications when Claude completes tasks or needs attention

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Git utilities: conventional commits with Jira extraction + safe push (blocks main/master)

plugins.name: playwright
plugins.description: Playwright MCP + agents pour les tests E2E automatises

plugins.name: statusline
plugins.description: Custom statusline with cost tracking, git info, and multi-plan support

plugins.name: experts
plugins.description: Senior architect agent for deep code analysis and evolution proposals

plugins.name: frustration-detector
plugins.description: Detects developer frustration and adapts Claude's response style (less talk, more action)

plugins.name: motion-studio
plugins.description: Motion design as code: HTML/CSS/SVG/Canvas animations rendered frame by frame to MP4/WebM/GIF via Playwright + ffmpeg, with synced sound, voice-over and subtitles

plugins.name: kaizen
plugins.description: AI-assisted SDLC on the compound engineering loop: engineering constitution enforced as gates, plan with traceability/threats/rollout/PR-sized slices and independent doc review, test-first work with a Stop-hook quality gate, multi-agent code review, ship & PR babysitting, UI polish, learnings/ADRs/postmortems read back every cycle, DORA metrics, releases
